name: zumen-monorepo
description: Monorepo of zumen: read, view and measure 2D drawings (SXF, JWW, DXF; DWG planned) in the browser

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/sxf/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/jww/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/dxf/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm audit && pnpm run build && pnpm run playground:build
